name: dos-crafting-catalog
description: Katalog przedmiotów i receptur DOS1, DOS2 Definitive Edition i Crafting Overhaul

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && prettier src scripts/*.ts vite.config.ts eslint.config.js index.html package.json tsconfig.json .github/workflows/*.yml --check
scripts.format: prettier src scripts/*.ts vite.config.ts eslint.config.js index.html package.json tsconfig.json .github/workflows/*.yml --write
scripts.lint:sonar: npm --prefix tools/sonar install --no-audit --no-fund && tools/sonar/node_modules/.bin/eslint src scripts vite.config.ts
